## SPM

### Merge Si's with General Gu

```{r}
## SGIS ver.

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1) 읽기
sgg <- st_read("bnd_sigungu_00_2024_2Q/bnd_sigungu_00_2024_2Q.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# 2) 좌표계 (5186 고정)
crs_now <- st_crs(sgg)
if (is.na(crs_now)) {
  sgg <- st_set_crs(sgg, 5186)
} else if (is.na(crs_now$epsg) || crs_now$epsg != 5186) {
  sgg <- st_transform(sgg, 5186)
}
sgg <- st_make_valid(sgg)

# 4) 캐릭터 변환
sgg <- sgg %>%
  mutate(
    SIGUNGU_CD = as.character(SIGUNGU_CD),
    SIGUNGU_NM = as.character(SIGUNGU_NM)
  )

# 5) "XX시 ~~구"면 "XX시"로 병합, 코드는 끝자리 0으로
is_city_gu <- grepl("시\\s*.+구$", sgg$SIGUNGU_NM)
base_city  <- ifelse(
  is_city_gu,
  sub("^\\s*([^\\s]+?시)\\s+.*구\\s*$", "\\1", sgg$SIGUNGU_NM),
  sgg$SIGUNGU_NM
)

mk_code0 <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x); n <- nchar(x)
  ifelse(n >= 1, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 1), "0"), x)
}

sgg2 <- sgg %>%
  mutate(
    new_sigungu_nm = base_city,
    new_sigungu_cd = ifelse(is_city_gu, mk_code0(SIGUNGU_CD), SIGUNGU_CD)
  )

sgg_merged <- sgg2 %>%
  group_by(new_sigungu_cd, new_sigungu_nm) %>%
  summarise(SIGUNGU_NM = dplyr::first(SIGUNGU_NM),
            .groups   = "drop",
            do_union  = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid()

cat("before =", nrow(sgg), " / after =", nrow(sgg_merged), "\n")

dir.create("sgis_sgg_merged", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ★ 필드명·한글 모두 걱정 없는 GPKG로 저장
st_write(
  sgg_merged,
  "sgis_sgg_merged/SGG_merged.gpkg",
  delete_dsn = TRUE,
  quiet      = TRUE
)

```



### 1st order Queen

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(spdep)
library(Matrix)

# # 1) merged sgg 로드 + 정렬 + idx
# sgg <- st_read("sgis_sgg_merged/SGG_merged.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)
# 
# if (st_is_longlat(sgg)) sgg <- st_transform(sgg, 5179)
# 
# sgg <- sgg %>%
#   arrange(new_sigungu_cd) %>%
#   mutate(idx = row_number())

sgg <- sgg_idx

path_q <- "dt_q_mod.csv"
dt_q <- read.csv(
  path_q,
  fileEncoding = "euc-kr",   # 파일이 euc-kr로 저장됨
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
setDT(dt_q)

dt_q <- dt_q %>%
  mutate(new_sigungu_cd = sgg_code_sgis)

# (선택) 실제 분석 데이터(dt_q)에 존재하는 시군구만 남기기
# dt_q에 new_sigungu_cd가 있다면 이게 가장 안전함
if ("new_sigungu_cd" %in% names(dt_q)) {
  keep_codes <- sort(unique(dt_q$new_sigungu_cd))
  sgg <- sgg %>%
    filter(new_sigungu_cd %in% keep_codes) %>%
    arrange(new_sigungu_cd) %>%
    mutate(idx = row_number())
}

N <- nrow(sgg)
cat("Graph N =", N, "\n")

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# 1) 투영 + 유효화
sgg2 <- sgg |>
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(5179)

sgg_nb_s <- st_simplify(sgg2, dTolerance = 50, preserveTopology = TRUE)

# 4) rook 인접 (5179이므로 snap은 '미터' 단위)
system.time({
  nb_geo <- poly2nb(sgg_nb_s, queen = TRUE, snap = 1)  # 1m
})

coords <- st_coordinates(st_point_on_surface(sgg))
knn1   <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 1))

nb_final <- make.sym.nb(union.nb(nb_geo, knn1))

# 3) adjacency matrix (binary) → INLA graph
W <- nb2mat(nb_final, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(dim(W) == c(N, N)))

INLA::inla.write.graph(W, file = "sgg_graph.adj")
G <- INLA::inla.read.graph("sgg_graph.adj")

# 4) 매핑 저장: 코드 ↔ idx
write.csv(
  data.frame(idx = sgg$idx, new_sigungu_cd = sgg$new_sigungu_cd),
  "sgg_graph_nodes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
```

```{r}
# (중요) nb를 만들 때 사용했던 sgg와 "행 순서"가 동일해야 함
# 대표점: 폴리곤 내부 보장 -> point_on_surface 추천
cent <- st_point_on_surface(sgg) %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>% 
  mutate(idx = row_number())

coords <- st_coordinates(cent)

# nb(list) -> edge list (중복 제거 위해 i < j)
edge_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(nb_final), function(i) {
  js <- nb_final[[i]]
  if (length(js) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(i = i, j = js)
}))
edge_df <- subset(edge_df, i < j)

# edge -> LINESTRING
lines <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(edge_df)), function(k) {
  i <- edge_df$i[k]; j <- edge_df$j[k]
  st_linestring(rbind(coords[i, 1:2], coords[j, 1:2]))
})

skeleton <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(lines, crs = st_crs(sgg)))

g <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sgg, fill = NA, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = skeleton, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = cent, color = "red", size = 1.1) +
  theme_void() +
  coord_sf()

print(g)
ggsave("SGG_adj_from_lw.png", g,
       width = 11, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```
### 2nd order Queen

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2차(누적) Queen 인접 + (고립만) kNN=1 보정 + INLA graph 저장
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)
  library(spdep)
  library(Matrix)
  library(data.table)
  library(INLA)
})

# ----------------------------
# 0) sgg 준비
# ----------------------------
sgg <- sgg_idx

# ----------------------------
# 1) 분석 데이터 로드 + 시군구 필터링/정렬
# ----------------------------
path_q <- "dt_q_mod.csv"
dt_q <- read.csv(path_q, fileEncoding = "euc-kr", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data.table::setDT(dt_q)

dt_q <- dt_q %>% mutate(new_sigungu_cd = sgg_code_sgis)

if ("new_sigungu_cd" %in% names(dt_q)) {
  keep_codes <- sort(unique(dt_q$new_sigungu_cd))
  sgg <- sgg %>%
    filter(new_sigungu_cd %in% keep_codes) %>%
    arrange(new_sigungu_cd) %>%
    mutate(idx = row_number())
}

N <- nrow(sgg)
cat("Graph N =", N, "\n")

# ----------------------------
# 2) Geometry 정리 (5179, valid)
# ----------------------------
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

sgg2 <- sgg |>
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(5179)

# (선택) 단순화 (인접 바뀔 수 있으니 보수적으로)
sgg_nb_s <- st_simplify(sgg2, dTolerance = 50, preserveTopology = TRUE)

ids <- as.character(sgg2$new_sigungu_cd)

# ----------------------------
# 3) Queen 1차 + 2차(누적) 인접 만들기
# ----------------------------
t_nb <- system.time({
  nb_q1 <- poly2nb(
    sgg_nb_s,
    queen = TRUE,
    snap = 1,                 # meter
    row.names = ids
  )
})
print(t_nb)

# 2차 lag 생성
lags <- spdep::nblag(nb_q1, maxlag = 2)

# 1차+2차 누적(보통 말하는 "2차 인접 누적")
nb_tmp <- spdep::nblag_cumul(lags)[[2]]

# ---- 여기서 nb 객체로 "정규화" (중요) ----
if (!inherits(nb_tmp, "nb")) {
  if (is.list(nb_tmp) && length(nb_tmp) == N) {
    nb_tmp <- lapply(nb_tmp, function(v) as.integer(v))
    class(nb_tmp) <- "nb"
    attr(nb_tmp, "region.id") <- ids
  } else {
    stop("nblag_cumul(lags)[[2]] 결과가 nb로 해석되지 않습니다. 객체 구조를 확인하세요.")
  }
}
nb_geo_2 <- nb_tmp

cat("class(nb_geo_2) =", paste(class(nb_geo_2), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ----------------------------
# 4) isolate 보정: 고립된 것만 kNN=1로 연결
# ----------------------------
coords <- st_coordinates(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(sgg2)))  # 경고 최소화

knn1 <- knn2nb(
  knearneigh(coords, k = 1),
  row.names = ids
)

iso <- which(spdep::card(nb_geo_2) == 0)
cat("isolates (before fix) =", length(iso), "\n")

if (length(iso) > 0) {
  nb_fix <- nb_geo_2
  for (i in iso) nb_fix[[i]] <- knn1[[i]]
  nb_final_2 <- make.sym.nb(nb_fix)
} else {
  nb_final_2 <- make.sym.nb(nb_geo_2)
}

cat("isolates (after fix)  =", sum(spdep::card(nb_final_2) == 0), "\n")
cat("components (before) =", n.comp.nb(nb_geo_2)$nc, "\n")
cat("components (after)  =", n.comp.nb(nb_final_2)$nc, "\n")

# ----------------------------
# 5) adjacency matrix (binary) → INLA graph 저장
# ----------------------------
W <- nb2mat(nb_final_2, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(dim(W) == c(N, N)))

INLA::inla.write.graph(W, file = "sgg_graph_2.adj")
G <- INLA::inla.read.graph("sgg_graph_2.adj")

# ----------------------------
# 6) 매핑 저장: 코드 ↔ idx
# ----------------------------
write.csv(
  data.frame(idx = sgg$idx, new_sigungu_cd = sgg$new_sigungu_cd),
  "sgg_graph_nodes_2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

cat("DONE: sgg_graph_2.adj / sgg_graph_nodes_2.csv\n")


```

### distance-based
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(spdep)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# sgg: (중요) dt_q로 필터링/정렬된 동일 객체라고 가정
sgg_use <- sgg |>
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(5179)

N <- nrow(sgg_use)

# 대표점(폴리곤 내부 보장)
cent  <- st_point_on_surface(sgg_use)
coords <- st_coordinates(cent)  # (N x 2), 단위: meter

# ----------------------------
# (1) 거리 기반 이웃: threshold
# ----------------------------
dmax <- 60000  # 예: 60km (meter)
nb_d <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = dmax, longlat = FALSE)

# 고립 방지(필수 권장): 1-NN을 union
knn1 <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 1))
nb_d <- make.sym.nb(union.nb(nb_d, knn1))

# ----------------------------
# (2) 거리감쇠 가중치: exp(-d/r)
# ----------------------------
dlist <- nbdists(nb_d, coords)

range_m <- 30000  # 감쇠 스케일(예: 30km). 값 커질수록 완만해짐
wlist  <- lapply(dlist, function(d) exp(-d / range_m))

# INLA용: weighted adjacency sparse matrix (대칭화)
i <- rep(seq_along(nb_d), card(nb_d))
j <- unlist(nb_d)
w <- unlist(wlist)

Ww <- sparseMatrix(i = i, j = j, x = w, dims = c(N, N))
Ww <- (Ww + t(Ww)) / 2
diag(Ww) <- 0

INLA::inla.write.graph(Ww, file = "sgg_graph_dist.adj")
G_dist <- INLA::inla.read.graph("sgg_graph_dist.adj")

# (선택) 매핑 저장
write.csv(
  data.frame(idx = seq_len(N), new_sigungu_cd = sgg_use$new_sigungu_cd),
  "sgg_graph_nodes_dist.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

# ----------------------------
# (3) 스켈레톤 시각화 (가중치 반영 alpha)
# ----------------------------
edge_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(nb_d), function(ii) {
  js <- nb_d[[ii]]
  if (!length(js)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(i = ii, j = js, w = wlist[[ii]])
}))
edge_df <- subset(edge_df, i < j)

lines <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(edge_df)), function(k) {
  ii <- edge_df$i[k]; jj <- edge_df$j[k]
  st_linestring(rbind(coords[ii, 1:2], coords[jj, 1:2]))
})

skeleton <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(lines, crs = st_crs(sgg_use))) |>
  mutate(w = edge_df$w)

cent_sf <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(st_multipoint(coords), crs = st_crs(sgg_use))) |>
  st_cast("POINT") |>
  mutate(idx = seq_len(N))

g <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sgg_use, fill = NA, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = skeleton, aes(alpha = w), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cent_sf, color = "red", size = 1.1) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.2, 0.9), guide = "none") +
  theme_void()

print(g)
ggsave("SGG_dist_skeleton.png", g, width = 11, height = 11, dpi = 300)

```
